title: Quick Grilled American Chicken Skewers
description: A jammy and crumbly American dish featuring chicken thighs, grilled to perfection on a robata grill and served in a scallop shell, this recipe is FODMAP friendly and perfect for a show-off dinner party
instructions: Preheat the robata grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit
Cut the chicken thighs into 1 inch pieces and thread onto skewers
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic free seasoning, salt, and black pepper
Brush the mixture onto the chicken pieces
Grill the chicken skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally
While the chicken is cooking, prepare the scallop shells by rinsing them with water and patting them dry
Once the chicken is cooked, place a skewer in each scallop shell
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley and serve immediately
